decisions.decision: The Board endorsed the ANR plans for 380, 390 and 400 Electric Avenue and for 53 Prospect Street; no motion is recorded.
All minutes were accepted (07/24/17 and 07/24/17, 40 Pioneer Drive & 98 Leominster Shirley Road); no motion is recorded.

The property owner at 5 & 9 Electric Avenue will be invited to the Board meeting to address issues; if a Site Plan Approval Application is submitted before the September 11 meeting, the Board will forego the review.
